back: When all people, at all times, can obtain enough safe and nutritious food for an active and healthy life.

Food, or money for food, given by governments, the World Food Programme or charities to people without enough to eat.
Drought, floods and cyclones, pests (locusts, fall armyworm), crop and animal diseases, poor soils, climate change.

For: saves lives in emergencies, food-for-work builds assets. Against: dependency, lower local prices, delays, tied aid, ignores causes.
